heading.title: Of Offences Affecting the Human Body

article.title: Unlawful compulsory labour
article.content: Whoever unlawfully compels any person to labour against the will of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both.
article.html:
146Unlawful compulsory labour

Section 146 · Chapter VI · Of kidnapping, abduction, slavery and forced labour

Whoever unlawfully compels any person to labour against the will of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both.
